'''Pidilite Industries Limited''' is an Indian [[adhesive]]s manufacturing company based in [[Andheri]] (East), [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pidilite.com/|title=Pidilite Website|accessdate=2017-09-02}}</ref> The company is the leading adhesives manufacturer in India.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Somvanshi |first=Kiran Kabtta |date=1 December 2018 |title=Pidilite: Glued firmly to the growth path |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/pidilite-glued-firmly-to-the-growth-path/articleshow/66892279.cms |access-date=2022-05-08}}</ref> Pidilite also manufactures products in verticals such as art materials and stationery; food and fabric care; car products, adhesives, and sealants; and speciality industrial products like adhesives, pigments; textile resins, leather chemicals, and construction chemicals.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/20411624|title=Salil Dalal, COO - Emerging India, Pidilite Industries Ltd|website=www.bloomberg.com}}</ref>

Pidilite markets the [[Fevicol]] range of adhesives. Its other brands are FeviKwik, FeviGum, Fevicryl, Dr. Fixit, D-klog, Roff, Cyclo, Ranipal, Hobby Ideas, M-seal, and Acron. Pidilite has launched ''Dr.Fixit Heatshield'', a heat-reducing exterior coating that is developed by R&D team in India & Singapore.<ref>{{cite web |author=Kunal Kumar |url=http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/chemical/200805169584.htm |title=Pidilite launches first of its kind Heat Reducing Exterior Coating |publisher=Indiaprwire.com |date= |accessdate=2010-07-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100415212135/http://www.indiaprwire.com/pressrelease/chemical/200805169584.htm |archive-date=15 April 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

The company has manufacturing facilities across India including in [[Mahad]] ([[Maharashtra]]), [[Vapi]] ([[Gujarat]]), [[Baddi]] and [[Kala Amb]] (both in [[Himachal Pradesh]]).

[[File:Electronica, Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (2025) 152.jpg|thumb|right|Pidilite and its collab partner CollTech Shenzen, at Electronica 2025, [[Bangalore International Exhibition Centre|BIEC]] ]]

==History==
The company was founded in 1959.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot_article.asp?ticker=878761 |title=About Pidilite Industries company |publisher=BusinessWeek |accessdate=2010-09-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121003103602/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot_article.asp?ticker=878761 |archive-date=3 October 2012 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Pidilite Industries Ltd |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/PIDI:IN |website=Bloomberg.com |access-date=October 26, 2021}}</ref> 

In 2015, Pidilite acquired a 70% majority stake in Nina Waterproofing Systems for {{INRconvert|100|c|year=2015|mode=historical}}.<ref>{{cite news |title=Pidilite to invest up to Rs 100 cr in Nina Waterproofing |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/chem-/-fertilisers/pidilite-to-invest-up-to-rs-100-cr-in-nina-waterproofing/articleshow/46749197.cms |access-date=14 February 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=30 March 2015}}</ref>

In 2016, Pidilite formed a joint venture with Industria Chimica Adriatica Spa (ICA), an Italian company.<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 April 2016 |title=Pidilite forms JV with Italy's ICA |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/pidilite-forms-jv-with-italys-ica/articleshow/52001356.cms |access-date=10 May 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> The joint venture is named ICA Pidilite.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Pullokaran |first=Jomy Jos |date=14 June 2024 |title=Pidilite Industries JV inks UV technology licensing pact with Italian partner |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/ica-pidilite-ica-pidilite-ventures-industria-chimica-adriatica-spa-uv-technology-ica-pidilite-jv-licenses-19428777.htm |access-date=11 May 2025 |website=CNBC TV18}}</ref>

In 2018, Pidilite acquired a 70% stake in CIPY Polyurethanes for {{INRconvert|96|c|year=2018|mode=historical}}.<ref>{{cite news |title=Pidilite Industries to acquire stake in CIPY Polyurethanes |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/pidilite-industries-to-acquire-stake-in-cipy-polyurethanes/articleshow/62382768.cms |access-date=14 February 2023 |work=The Times of India |date=5 January 2018}}</ref>

In 2020, Pidilite acquired [[Huntsman Corporation]]'s Indian subsidiary for {{INRconvert|2100|c|year=2020|mode=historical}} to strengthen their retail adhesives and sealants portfolio.<ref>{{cite web |title=Pidilite to acquire Huntsman unit for ₹2,100 crore |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/pidilite-to-acquire-huntsman-unit-for-2100-crore/article32969691.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=29 October 2020}}</ref>

In 2022, Pidilite Industries partnered with 100x.VC.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Times |first1=Economics |title=100xvc partners with Pidilite Industries |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/100x-vc-partners-with-pidilite-industries-for-venture-capital-arm/articleshow/94180690.cms?from=mdr}}</ref>

In 2023, Pidilite Industries formed two joint ventures: Pidilite Litokol with Litokol, an Italian company, and Tenax Pidilite with Tenax, also an Italian company.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=21 June 2023 |title=Pidilite Industries gains on launch of 2 new JV units with Italian firms |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/pidilite-industries-gains-on-launch-of-2-new-jv-units-with-italian-firms-10828761.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230625092757/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/pidilite-industries-gains-on-launch-of-2-new-jv-units-with-italian-firms-10828761.html |archive-date=25 June 2023 |access-date=10 May 2025 |website=Moneycontrol}}</ref> As part of the joint venture agreements, both Litokol and Tenax [[Technology transfer|transferred technology]] to Pidilite.<ref name=":0" /> In 2024, ICA Pidilite signed an agreement to license certain [[ultraviolet]] technologies from ICA.<ref name=":1" />
